definition: help given to a person or cause
description: A dim living room strung with fairy lights at dusk. A young man sits on a sofa wrapped in a striped knitted blanket, crying, holding a mug of tea in both hands. A friend beside him puts an arm round his shoulders and talks quietly to him. Two more friends sit down on either side, then a fourth, and they all lean in and hold him while he keeps crying with the mug in his hands.
transcript: Hey, hey. It's okay. We're here. Thanks.

taps.phrase: to clutch a mug of tea
to wrap him in a blanket

en.question: What are the friends around him doing?

de.answer: Sie umarmen ihn, um ihn zu unterstützen.
de.question: Was machen die Freunde um ihn herum?

es.answer: Lo están abrazando para mostrarle su apoyo.
es.question: ¿Qué están haciendo los amigos que lo rodean?

fr.answer: Ils le serrent dans leurs bras pour le soutenir.
